# Large Markdown Stress Test

Generated fixture (`crates/app/benches/fixtures/generate_stress_markdown.py`, seed 1337, deterministic) for future criterion benchmarks of `text_editor`'s rendering internals — see CLAUDE.md's Backlog entry on why `jade-app` can't link a real criterion bench against them yet. Exercises every construct Live Preview renders — headings, bold/italic, inline code, strikethrough, wikilinks (plain/aliased/heading-anchored), inline links, bracketed/bare autolinks, HTML entities, backslash escapes, blockquotes (including nesting and compounding), unordered/ordered/task lists (including nesting, lazy continuation, and compounding), tables (including very wide/tall ones), fenced code, thematic breaks, and Obsidian-style callouts (every built-in type/alias, custom titles, fold markers, an unrecognized type, and nested callouts) — at both a repeated "typical note" scale and a handful of deliberately extreme single elements (one huge table, one very long line, one huge fenced code block, deep list/blockquote nesting, dense link/entity paragraphs) meant to stress specific code paths beyond what repetition alone would reach.
